recommendation: promote-candidate for confirmation: p0f13 (B only, agent2/night/scratch/B084/p0f13B.asm). Screen ALL +0.0178 [-0.0001,+0.0356], no clearly negative group; it is the zero-instruction union of B064 p0f and B054 fix2steal's steal and its per-cohort diffs are exactly their sum. Caveats: the gain sits in ~5 cohorts (sstrong-1, s2025-10, sstrong-4, zrl03, ah02), the 2025 group is flat, fix2steal alone confirmed at only +0.0058 pooled, and vs tailored zchain4-body counters with late searches/late [0CC13h] writes it is about -0.03 (n.s.). It is also a natural B side for the planned C2-A + SD + Z1 combination (Z1 replaces the b/d-path 0E070E17 INT87, p0f13 touches the b/d search constants and startup; check overlap before merging). If the cell race matters, test p0f2c (untested source provided).
